# Web-search-backend config (v1)

Schema for `.tera/web-search-backends/<name>.hcl` config files. Each decodes to `pkg/config.WebSearchBackendBlock` configuring a web-search provider the web tools resolve against. The block label is the backend name.

| | |
|---|---|
| Registry name | `config/web-search-backends` |
| Regime | persisted |
| Identity regime | `inventory` — the block label is the identity; the file is a container and its stem carries no meaning (ADR-087 D3) |
| Current version | `v1` |
| Supported versions | `v1` |
| HCL block | `web_search_backend` |
| Loader directory | `.tera/web-search-backends/<name>.hcl` |
| Go source | `github.com/kottera/kottera/pkg/config.WebSearchBackendBlock` |
| Served at | `GET /api/v1/schemas/config/web-search-backends/reference` |

## Example

A minimal `web-search-backends`: every required attribute, exactly one member of each closed union, and nothing optional beyond what the kind would otherwise render empty. It is generated from the same source these tables are, and the same bytes are run through `tera validate` by the ADR-087 D9 pattern-transfer test — so it cannot describe a shape the loader does not accept.

Cross-references name the other kinds' examples (`example-worker`, `example-tool`, …) because every kind's example is validated together with the rest, as one vault.

`.tera/web-search-backends/example-web-search-backend.hcl`:

```hcl
version = "v1"

web_search_backend "example-web-search-backend" {
  type = "brave"
}
```
